- Hop P1 ← P3 (non-covered service charge for 9/29): **state-derived**. Records: 9/29 billed visit allowed 0.00, waiver signed 9/22 for 9/29, no non_covered_service charge. "non-covered service charge" finds `noncovered_visit_charge_entry_8608692f`.
